shift_from

cjr.examples.array_list.shift_from

definition shift_from:
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(doff, i, len, type(nat))
    type:
        list(Z)
    body:
        append:
            take(add(doff, i), xs)
            append:
                take(subtract(len, i), drop(add(add(doff, i), 1), xs))
                drop(add(doff, len), xs)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition shift_from (xs : list Z) (doff i len : nat) : list Z :=
  take (doff + i) xs ++
  take (len - i) (drop (doff + i + 1) xs) ++
  drop (doff + len) xs.

shift_from_step

cjr.examples.array_list.shift_from_step

lemma shift_from_step:
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(doff, i, len, type(nat))
    parameter(x, type(Z))
    statement:
        arrow:
            in_scope nat(less_than(i, len))
            arrow:
                in_scope nat(less_than(add(doff, len), length(xs)))
                arrow:
                    equals(lookup(xs, add(add(doff, i), 1)), Some(x))
                    equals:
                        shift_from(xs, doff, i, len)
                        shift_from:
                            apply:
                                notation "<[ _ := _ ]>":
                                    add(doff, i)
                                    x
                                xs
                            doff
                            S(i)
                            len
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma shift_from_step (xs : list Z) (doff i len : nat) (x : Z) :
  (i < len)%nat → (doff + len < length xs)%nat →
  xs !! (doff + i + 1) = Some x →
  shift_from xs doff i len = shift_from (<[doff + i := x]> xs) doff (S i) len.

definition is_buf:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(slots, type(list(Z)))

    type:
        iProp(Σ)
    body:
        exists:
            binders:
                parameter(o, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(base, type(_ (inferred)))
            separately:
                pure(equals(buf, LitV(LitObj(o))))
                separately:
                    owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 0, LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(length(slots)))))
                    separately:
                        owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 1, LitV(LitPtr(base)))
                        separately:
                            owns_block(RawId(base), length(slots))
                            array_cells(base, slots)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition is_buf (slots : list Z) (buf : val_cjr) : iProp Σ :=
    ∃ o base, ⌜ buf = LitV (LitObj o) ⌝ ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[0] LitV (LitInt (Z.of_nat (length slots))) ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[1] LitV (LitPtr base) ∗
      RawId base ↦ᵦ length slots ∗
      array_cells base slots.

definition is_arraylist:

        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(cap, type(nat))
    parameter(ver, type(Z))
    parameter(a, type(val_cjr))
    type:
        iProp(Σ)
    body:
        exists:
            binders:
                parameter(o, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(buf, type(_ (inferred)))
            separately:
                pure(equals(a, LitV(LitObj(o))))
                separately:
                    pure(in_scope nat(less_or_equal(length(xs), cap)))
                    separately:
                        pure(in_scope nat(less_than(0, cap)))
                        separately:
                            owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 0, buf)
                            separately:
                                owns_object_field:
                                    ObjId(o)
                                    1
                                    LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(length(xs))))
                                separately:
                                    owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 2, LitV(LitInt(ver)))
                                    is_buf(slots_of(xs, cap), buf)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition is_arraylist (xs : list Z) (cap : nat) (ver : Z) (a : val_cjr) : iProp Σ :=
    ∃ o buf, ⌜ a = LitV (LitObj o) ⌝ ∗
      ⌜ (length xs ≤ cap)%nat ⌝ ∗
      ⌜ (0 < cap)%nat ⌝ ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[0] buf ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[1] LitV (LitInt (Z.of_nat (length xs))) ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[2] LitV (LitInt ver) ∗
      is_buf (slots_of xs cap) buf.

    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))

        arrow:
            in_scope nat(equals(subtract(len, i), n))
            arrow:
                in_scope nat(less_or_equal(i, len))
                arrow:
                    in_scope nat(less_or_equal(add(soff, len), length(srcSlots)))
                    arrow:
                        in_scope nat(less_or_equal(add(doff, len), length(dstSlots)))
                        consuming_implies:
                            owns_stack(StackId(li), LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(i))))
                            consuming_implies:

                                consuming_implies:

                                    wp_partial:
                                        copy_while:
                                            li

                                            dst
                                            Z.of_nat(soff)
                                            Z.of_nat(doff)
                                            Z.of_nat(len)
                                        post binder(v)
                                        postcondition:
                                            separately:

                                                    owns_stack:

                                                        LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(len)))
                                                    separately:

                                                        array_cells:
                                                            dst
                                                            overwrite:
                                                                dstSlots

                                                                take:
                                                                    subtract(len, i)
                                                                    drop:
                                                                        add(soff, i)
                                                                        srcSlots

    (soff + len ≤ length srcSlots)%nat →
    (doff + len ≤ length dstSlots)%nat →

    array_cells src srcSlots -∗

          array_cells src srcSlots ∗

grow_alloc_spec

cjr.examples.array_list.grow_alloc_spec · array_list

lemma grow_alloc_spec:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(xs, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(cap, newCap, type(nat))
    parameter(ver, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(ao, type(loc))
    parameter(base, type(Z))
    parameter(old, type(val))
    statement:
        arrow:
            in_scope nat(less_or_equal(length(xs), cap))
            arrow:
                in_scope nat(less_or_equal(length(xs), newCap))
                arrow:
                    in_scope nat(less_than(0, newCap))
                    consuming_implies:
                        owns_object_field(ObjId(ao), 0, old)
                        consuming_implies:
                            owns_object_field:
                                ObjId(ao)
                                1
                                LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(length(xs))))
                            consuming_implies:
                                owns_object_field(ObjId(ao), 2, LitV(LitInt(ver)))
                                consuming_implies:
                                    array_cells(base, slots_of(xs, cap))
                                    wp_partial:
                                        grow_alloc_e:
                                            ao
                                            Z.of_nat(newCap)
                                            base
                                            Z.of_nat(length(xs))
                                        post binder(v)
                                        postcondition:
                                            separately:
                                                pure(equals(v, LitV(LitUnit)))
                                                is_arraylist:
                                                    xs
                                                    newCap
                                                    ver
                                                    LitV(LitObj(ao))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma grow_alloc_spec xs (cap newCap : nat) ver (ao : loc) (base : Z) (old : val) :
    (length xs ≤ cap)%nat → (length xs ≤ newCap)%nat → (0 < newCap)%nat →
    ObjId ao ↦ₒ[0] old -∗
    ObjId ao ↦ₒ[1] LitV (LitInt (Z.of_nat (length xs))) -∗
    ObjId ao ↦ₒ[2] LitV (LitInt ver) -∗
    array_cells base (slots_of xs cap) -∗
    WP grow_alloc_e ao (Z.of_nat newCap) base (Z.of_nat (length xs))
      {{ v, ⌜ v = LitV LitUnit ⌝ ∗ is_arraylist xs newCap ver (LitV (LitObj ao)) }}.

lemma add_open_spec:

    statement:

            is_arraylist(xs, cap, ver, LitV(LitObj(ao)))
            wp_partial:
                add_open(ao, x)
                post binder(v)
                postcondition:
                    separately:
                        pure(equals(v, LitV(LitUnit)))
                        is_arraylist:
                            al_add(xs, x)
                            add_cap(cap, length(xs))
                            in_scope Z(add(ver, 1))
                            LitV(LitObj(ao))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma add_open_spec (xs : list Z) (cap : nat) (ver : Z) (ao : loc) (x : Z) :
    is_arraylist xs cap ver (LitV (LitObj ao)) -∗
    WP add_open ao x
      {{ v, ⌜ v = LitV LitUnit ⌝ ∗
            is_arraylist (al_add xs x) (add_cap cap (length xs)) (ver + 1)%Z
              (LitV (LitObj ao)) }}.

definition remove_finish_e:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(ao, type(loc))
    parameter(n, p, y, type(Z))

        expr
    body:
        let_binding:
            Some("last")
            BinOp(MinusOp, Val(LitV(LitInt(n))), Val(LitV(LitInt(1))))
            let_binding:
                None
                store(Offset(Val(LitV(LitPtr(p))), Var("last")), Val(LitV(LitInt(0))))
                let_binding:
                    None
                    FieldStore(Val(LitV(LitObj(ao))), 1, Var("last"))
                    let_binding:
                        Some("ver")
                        FieldLoad(Val(LitV(LitObj(ao))), 2)
                        let_binding:
                            None
                            FieldStore:
                                Val(LitV(LitObj(ao)))
                                2
                                BinOp(PlusOp, Var("ver"), Val(LitV(LitInt(1))))
                            Val(LitV(LitInt(y)))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition remove_finish_e (ao : loc) (n p y : Z) : expr :=
    Let (Some "last") (BinOp MinusOp (Val (LitV (LitInt n))) (Val (LitV (LitInt 1))))
      (Let None
        (Store (Offset (Val (LitV (LitPtr p))) (Var "last")) (Val (LitV (LitInt 0))))
        (Let None
          (FieldStore (Val (LitV (LitObj ao))) 1 (Var "last"))
          (Let (Some "ver") (FieldLoad (Val (LitV (LitObj ao))) 2)
            (Let None
              (FieldStore (Val (LitV (LitObj ao))) 2
                (BinOp PlusOp (Var "ver") (Val (LitV (LitInt 1)))))
              (Val (LitV (LitInt y))))))).

remove_finish_spec

cjr.examples.array_list.remove_finish_spec · array_list

lemma remove_finish_spec:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(cap, j, type(nat))
    parameter(ver, y, type(Z))
    parameter(ao, ob, type(loc))
    parameter(base, type(Z))
    statement:
        arrow:
            in_scope nat(less_than(j, length(xs)))
            arrow:
                in_scope nat(less_or_equal(length(xs), cap))
                arrow:
                    in_scope nat(less_than(0, cap))
                    arrow:
                        equals(lookup(xs, j), Some(y))
                        consuming_implies:
                            owns_object_field(ObjId(ao), 0, LitV(LitObj(ob)))
                            consuming_implies:
                                owns_object_field:
                                    ObjId(ao)
                                    1
                                    LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(length(xs))))
                                consuming_implies:
                                    owns_object_field(ObjId(ao), 2, LitV(LitInt(ver)))
                                    consuming_implies:
                                        owns_object_field:
                                            ObjId(ob)
                                            0
                                            LitV(LitInt(Z.of_nat(cap)))
                                        consuming_implies:
                                            owns_object_field:
                                                ObjId(ob)
                                                1
                                                LitV(LitPtr(base))
                                            consuming_implies:
                                                owns_block(RawId(base), cap)
                                                consuming_implies:
                                                    array_cells:
                                                        base
                                                        shift_from:
                                                            slots_of(xs, cap)
                                                            j
                                                            0
                                                            subtract:
                                                                subtract(length(xs), j)
                                                                1
                                                    wp_partial:
                                                        remove_finish_e:
                                                            ao
                                                            Z.of_nat(length(xs))
                                                            base
                                                            y
                                                        post binder(v)
                                                        postcondition:
                                                            separately:
                                                                pure:
                                                                    equals:
                                                                        v
                                                                        LitV(LitInt(y))
                                                                is_arraylist:
                                                                    al_remove(xs, j)
                                                                    cap
                                                                    in_scope Z(add(ver, 1))
                                                                    LitV(LitObj(ao))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma remove_finish_spec (xs : list Z) (cap j : nat) (ver y : Z)
      (ao ob : loc) (base : Z) :
    (j < length xs)%nat → (length xs ≤ cap)%nat → (0 < cap)%nat →
    xs !! j = Some y →
    ObjId ao ↦ₒ[0] LitV (LitObj ob) -∗
    ObjId ao ↦ₒ[1] LitV (LitInt (Z.of_nat (length xs))) -∗
    ObjId ao ↦ₒ[2] LitV (LitInt ver) -∗
    ObjId ob ↦ₒ[0] LitV (LitInt (Z.of_nat cap)) -∗
    ObjId ob ↦ₒ[1] LitV (LitPtr base) -∗
    RawId base ↦ᵦ cap -∗
    array_cells base (shift_from (slots_of xs cap) j 0 (length xs - j - 1)) -∗
    WP remove_finish_e ao (Z.of_nat (length xs)) base y
      {{ v, ⌜ v = LitV (LitInt y) ⌝ ∗
            is_arraylist (al_remove xs j) cap (ver + 1)%Z (LitV (LitObj ao)) }}.

remove_open_spec

cjr.examples.array_list.remove_open_spec · array_list

lemma remove_open_spec:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(cap, j, type(nat))
    parameter(ver, y, type(Z))
    parameter(ao, type(loc))
    statement:
        arrow:
            in_scope nat(less_than(j, length(xs)))
            arrow:
                equals(lookup(xs, j), Some(y))
                consuming_implies:
                    is_arraylist(xs, cap, ver, LitV(LitObj(ao)))
                    wp_partial:
                        remove_open(ao, Z.of_nat(j))
                        post binder(v)
                        postcondition:
                            separately:
                                pure(equals(v, LitV(LitInt(y))))
                                is_arraylist:
                                    al_remove(xs, j)
                                    cap
                                    in_scope Z(add(ver, 1))
                                    LitV(LitObj(ao))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma remove_open_spec (xs : list Z) (cap j : nat) (ver y : Z) (ao : loc) :
    (j < length xs)%nat → xs !! j = Some y →
    is_arraylist xs cap ver (LitV (LitObj ao)) -∗
    WP remove_open ao (Z.of_nat j)
      {{ v, ⌜ v = LitV (LitInt y) ⌝ ∗
            is_arraylist (al_remove xs j) cap (ver + 1)%Z (LitV (LitObj ao)) }}.
